plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Early Childhood Education, AAS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/early-childhood-education-aas/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Early Childhood Education Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The plan footnotes numbered 3 and 4 in the schedule grid are not defined on this page — those slots are modeled as choice slots with an honest 'not defined on this page; see advisor' note. Students choose electives in preschool, infant/toddler, or administration. All ECE degrees require field experience and practicum (fingerprints, background check, TB test required). Accredited by NAEYC ECADA. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
